description: This file is a shell script containing a sequence of test cases for the 'git rebase' functionality. It sets up repositories, performs rebase operations under various scenarios, verifies author information, commit timestamps, notes, and interactions with worktrees and configuration options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a code block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares content of files or strings.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions of files or commits.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances logical time for commit timestamp testing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or adjusts configuration settings temporarily for testing.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that may fail without halting the script.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
